summary: This is a legitimate job posting from Royal Bank of Canada, Canada's largest bank by market capitalization. RBC is an established, publicly-traded financial institution with 94,544+ employees worldwide, a professional careers portal at jobs.rbc.com, strong Glassdoor ratings (3.9/5 stars, 11,058 reviews), and extensive web presence including LinkedIn and news coverage. The posting is for an entry-level Software Developer role within RBC's AI Group (RBC Borealis), which is confirmed as an active AI innovation unit headquartered at RBC Waterpark Place in Toronto. The job description is specific and detailed, aligned with actual market trends for entry-level backend/cloud roles in financial services. No sensitive PII is requested upfront. The lack of salary disclosure, while atypical for tech, is consistent with RBC's standard practice and matches patterns observed in the market analysis for established financial services companies. All verifiable details check out: the company, location, technologies, and experience level are authentic and consistent with legitimate RBC hiring.
recommendation: This posting is safe to pursue. RBC is a legitimate, well-established employer with a strong reputation for mentorship and graduate development programs. You can proceed with confidence submitting your application through the official RBC careers portal (jobs.rbc.com). During the application and interview process, standard precautions apply: do not share sensitive personal information (SSN, SIN, banking details, government ID copies) before receiving a formal offer. Request detailed information about compensation during initial conversations. The role offers genuine opportunity for learning modern cloud engineering practices and AI/ML concepts in a supportive environment with access to top-tier engineering tools and mentorship.

whois_summary.notes: WHOIS lookup completed successfully. Domain is well-established (32+ years old) and registered under the official company name. Expiration date is current and well-maintained, indicating active corporate domain management.

signals.title: Established, Publicly-Traded Company
signals.evidence: Royal Bank of Canada is Canada's largest bank by market capitalization with 94,544 full-time employees worldwide and 69,126 in Canada. Founded in 1864, it serves 19+ million clients globally and is recognized as one of the world's largest banks.
signals.why_it_matters: Long-standing, large corporations with public filings have legal accountability and regulatory oversight. This drastically reduces fraud risk compared to startups or unknown entities.

signals.title: Official Domain Registered 32+ Years Ago
signals.evidence: The domain rbc.com was registered on 1994-10-24 by Royal Bank of Canada and is currently valid through 2026-10-23. The registrar is GoDaddy Corporate Domains, LLC.
signals.why_it_matters: A domain registered three decades ago under the company's own name is extremely strong evidence of legitimacy. Scammers rarely maintain or acquire old, established domains.

signals.title: Official Careers Portal with Active Postings
signals.evidence: RBC operates a professional careers portal at jobs.rbc.com with hundreds of active postings across multiple roles, locations, and levels. The portal includes dedicated pages for Tech@RBC and early talent programs. Multiple confirmed RBC postings are visible on this portal, including similar Software Developer and AI Group roles.
signals.why_it_matters: A dedicated, professional careers infrastructure is a hallmark of legitimate major employers. This cannot be easily faked.

signals.title: Confirmed Physical Office Location
signals.evidence: RBC Waterpark Place, 88 Queens Quay W, Toronto is confirmed as an active RBC office location through multiple job postings for different roles and departments (Technology & Operations, Borealis AI).
signals.why_it_matters: The posting provides a verifiable, specific office address. Multiple postings from this address confirm it is a real RBC facility actively hiring, not a fabricated location.

signals.title: RBC Borealis (AI Group) is Confirmed Real
signals.evidence: RBC Borealis is identified as RBC's official AI and data innovation unit with teams across Toronto, Waterloo, Montreal, Calgary, and Vancouver. Confirmed through multiple sources including LinkedIn posts from VP Greg Mori, job postings, and official RBC communications. Posting mentions collaboration with 'infrastructure, platform, and ML teams' to support 'reliable AI systems,' which aligns with Borealis's stated mission.
signals.why_it_matters: This confirms the organizational structure referenced in the posting is real, and the AI/ML focus described is genuine within RBC's structure.

signals.title: Skills and Technologies Match Market Trends
signals.evidence: The posting requires Python (82% of market postings), Golang (45%), Java, REST APIs, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, CI/CD, and SQL—all in top 13 most common skills across analyzed software developer roles. These are the exact technologies demanded in 2026 software engineering market.
signals.why_it_matters: Scam postings often list generic or outdated tech stacks. This posting demonstrates detailed knowledge of actual market requirements for entry-level backend/cloud engineering roles.

signals.title: Entry-Level Role Properly Scoped
signals.evidence: The posting targets 0-2 years of experience (entry-level/new grad), emphasizes mentorship ('under senior engineer guidance'), and lists responsibilities appropriate for junior developers (code reviews, learning, unit tests, support). This matches the 7/11 (64%) entry-level heavy market pattern observed.
signals.why_it_matters: The role is accurately positioned for entry-level candidates, not misrepresenting as senior or claiming to require minimal experience for a complex role.

signals.title: Detailed, Role-Specific Responsibilities
signals.evidence: The job description is specific to AI service development, mentioning 'Building reliable APIs, backend services, and integration components for AI/ML applications,' 'Learning observability practices,' 'Collaborating with infrastructure, platform, and ML teams,' and 'Secure development principles.' This is not generic.
signals.why_it_matters: Scam postings typically use vague, copy-paste job descriptions. This demonstrates specific knowledge of the role and team.

signals.title: Strong Glassdoor Presence and Culture Alignment
signals.evidence: RBC has 11,058 Glassdoor reviews with a 3.9/5 rating. Employees consistently praise mentorship, supportive culture, and collaborative environment. The posting emphasizes 'learning,' 'mentorship,' and 'collaborative spirit,' which directly aligns with documented RBC culture.
signals.why_it_matters: Thousands of employee reviews from an independent third-party platform validate the company culture described in the posting.

signals.title: Active Hiring of 3,600+ New Graduates in Fiscal 2026
signals.evidence: Recent company news (confirmed in posting metadata) indicates RBC is actively hiring 3,600 new graduates in fiscal 2026 and hired 1,600 summer students in 2026. This aligns perfectly with the entry-level targeting of this posting.
signals.why_it_matters: The posting is consistent with verified company hiring announcements and large-scale graduate recruitment initiatives.

signals.title: Recent Awards and Recognition
signals.evidence: Recent news (July 17, 2026) confirms RBC received four top honours in Euromoney's 2026 Awards for Excellence (North America's Best Bank, Canada's Best Bank, Canada's Best Investment Bank). July 30, 2026 announcement of extended Vector Institute sponsorship through 2032 shows current investment in AI and talent development.
signals.why_it_matters: Recent positive media recognition and active institutional partnerships demonstrate the company is thriving and actively investing in technology and talent.

signals.title: Salary Not Disclosed
signals.evidence: The posting does not provide a salary range, only noting that 'the company mentions a comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses, flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable.' Market analysis shows entry-level RBC roles range $72K-$113.9K CAD.
signals.why_it_matters: While not a red flag (many RBC and financial services postings omit salary), lack of salary transparency makes initial evaluation harder. However, this is consistent with RBC's standard practice and the market analysis pattern for established financial services companies.

signals.title: No Upfront Payments or Personal Information Requests
signals.evidence: The posting makes no requests for sensitive personal information (SSN, SIN, government ID, banking details, date of birth) or upfront payments, training fees, or equipment purchases.
signals.why_it_matters: Absence of these major fraud indicators is a strong positive signal. Legitimate employers collect this information only after a formal offer and during onboarding.

user_safety_actions: Proceed with confidence. This is a legitimate posting from a major, established employer.
Apply through the official RBC careers portal at jobs.rbc.com to ensure you're interacting with authentic RBC systems.
During interviews and offer process, confirm any contact is from @rbc.com email addresses or verified RBC phone lines.
Do not share sensitive personal information (SIN, banking details, government ID) until after receiving a formal written offer and entering official onboarding.
If offered the role, verify compensation details in writing. Based on market analysis, entry-level RBC Software Developer roles typically range $72K-$113.9K CAD.
Research the specific team and hiring manager on LinkedIn to verify their presence at RBC if desired for additional confidence.
